description: Sends a request to the Softwear Prints sales team for an own online shop (staff shop, club or team shop, school, merchandise or event shop). Transmits the organisation, contact name, email address and the message to Softwear Prints; the sales team replies by email.

contact_name.description: Full name of the contact person.

email.description: Email address the sales team should reply to.

expected_users.description: Roughly how many people will order in the shop.

language.description: Language for the reply from the sales team.

message.description: What the shop is needed for: products, decoration, start date, questions.

organisation.description: Name of the company, club, school or organisation that wants the shop.

phone.description: Phone number for a call back.

shop_type.description: Kind of shop: company (staff shop), club (team shop), school, merchandise, event or other.

name: request_shop_setup
title: Request an own shop
